Little story about Henry Ford. Every grade school American History textbook mentions how Mr. Ford raised the wages of his factory workers above market value, so they could afford to buy the cars they produced. Little known fact: Ford was then sued by the shareholders for breach of fiduciary responsibility. He lost.

Google is a publicly traded company. Its CEO and board are bound by law to seek the greatest returns possible for shareholders. If they don't seek the highest returns, they can be sued. They have decided that it is no longer in the monetary interest of Google to subsidize legal costs for an entire industry.
